# Key mappings by plugin

<!-- Generated by scripts/keymaps.py --doc. Do not edit by hand. -->

The same mappings as [keymaps.md](keymaps.md), grouped by what they belong
to instead of by key. Each plugin's section holds both the keys declared in
its lazy.nvim `keys` spec and the ones it creates itself when it loads, so
`mini.surround` lists `sa` even though nothing in this repo writes that key.

Attribution is recorded during a real boot, from the file and line that
created each mapping -- see [keymaps.md](keymaps.md) for how.

## Plugins that define no mappings

Listed so the plugin set is accounted for. Plugins configured by one of
the multi-plugin spec files above are left out: a mapping in such a file
may belong to any of them, and this tool does not guess which.

`catppuccin`, `conform.nvim`, `lazy.nvim`, `lualine.nvim`, `mason-lspconfig.nvim`, `mason.nvim`, `mini.bufremove`, `mini.cursorword`, `mini.icons`, `mini.trailspace`, `nvim-dap-ui`, `nvim-dap-virtual-text`, `nvim-lint`, `nvim-nio`, `preview.nvim`, `render-markdown.nvim`, `smartcolumn.nvim`, `telescope-frecency.nvim`, `telescope-fzf-native.nvim`, `telescope-ui-select.nvim`.
